Resolves #22050
Related: #21942, neomjs/pages#199

Visitors switching to light can see the Mermaid editor and diagram, all six live metrics, the complete pie legend, and five Grid & Table demonstrations in the palette they selected. The change removes 138 lines of fixed viewport, crop and interaction recipes and adds eight existing catalog flags.

[Pages #199](https://github.com/neomjs/pages/pull/199) has merged and [deployed](https://github.com/neomjs/pages/actions/runs/45094063251). All sixteen files match both public hosts (32/32 responses). A fresh Chromium session with zero request interception then used the real Portal switch, decoded each image at 1280 × 720, and confirmed every public SHA-256.

Evidence: L3 (two gallery pages, native theme switch, decoded candidate files, source UI interactions) → L3 required.

Its recipe is still present. [Measured residual on #21942](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/21942#issuecomment-7088921518).

Frame critique: the older crops made individual pie labels, sparkline values and filter fields easier to read. The new openings show both Mermaid surfaces, six metrics, and the pager that explains what the server example does. In independent visual reads before the final baseline refresh, both readers preferred the new Charts gallery for choosing a demo. One rated Charts 7→8 and Grid 6→7, and both identified the smaller pie labels. Grid’s large dark featured example is outside these eight.
